name: 维斯洛
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1281
who: Wethlo, a blood-demon of the Crimson Feast line, a vanguard soldier of the Horned Plain war-band, a hundred and thirty-two years old and looking just past thirty: about 184 cm, tall and lean, long-limbed. Face pale with a faint bluish tinge, lips paler than other people's. Black hair worn short enough to show a pair of very small horns half hidden in it. Dark red eyes with narrow slit pupils (NOT round). A fresh thin cut always open on one fingertip of his right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us). A quiet, hungry, steady air, few words; he is never quite full.
build: 184 cm, tall and lean: narrow but wiry shoulders, a long thin torso, long stringy arms that never tremble.
palette: dull black leather and dark blood red, bluish pale skin, steel grey, a little bone white
casual: His vanguard soldier's gear: a suit of black boiled-leather armour with a dark red lineage stripe down the chest, plain dark trousers and worn boots; the burn scar under the armour is NOT visible. At his left hip a narrow, long, straight double-edged sword in a plain scabbard, its blade cut with fine blood grooves arranged in a pattern. He stands quietly with one hand resting on the pommel, a patient, hungry look.
private: Off duty beside the camp fire: the leather armour off, a plain loose dark linen shirt buttoned to the throat with the sleeves down, dark trousers, boots. He sits holding a tin cup of water and does not drink it, looking at the cup, a still, tired look.
battle: Charging with the vanguard: the black boiled-leather armour with its dark red lineage stripe, leather bracers, two small horns showing through the short hair. He holds the narrow straight sword drawn low at his side, the blood grooves glowing faintly red along the blade, the other hand open. A level, hungry, unwavering look.
formal: At a war-band muster: a long black wool coat with a plain open collar and a row of dull steel studs, worn over the black leather armour, a dark red sash across the chest, his hair swept back to show the two small horns. A narrow dark red lineage stripe runs down the coat front and the engraved blood grooves of the sheathed sword glow faintly through the scabbard. He stands at the very edge of the line with his hands at his sides, a quiet, level look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark red slit-pupil eyes looking steadily at the viewer, a pale bluish face with the small horns showing in the black hair, the mouth closed. Cold blue snow light from one side, a low red firelight from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snowflakes and one drop of blood on a fingertip. He wears the black leather armour with the dark red stripe.

name: 缇奥娜
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1335
who: Tiona, a long-lived demon-kin girl of the Horned Plain who is three hundred years old and still looks like a girl of sixteen or seventeen: small and slight, about 158 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. Skin pale with a faint blue tinge. Pale gold, almost white hair in two plaits hanging over her chest. Dark gold eyes that glow faintly at night. Her fingertips are dotted with tiny needle pricks, and a polished brass thimble sits on the left index finger (on the viewer's right when they face us). A gentle, patient, careful air; she can carry a sleeping child half a mile without waking them. The name embroidered on her cuff is a tiny row of abstract stitch-marks in an invented script of this world, never readable letters or a word. She has NO horns at all and no scales: the long-lived line of the demon-kin is smooth-browed, with nothing growing from the head, in every panel, in the portrait and in all nine expressions.
palette: pale grey and pale gold, dark gold eyes, polished brass, thread red, faded linen
casual: Her long-lived demon-kin robe: a pale grey long robe with wide sleeves closed at the neck, a name embroidered in tiny fine stitches on the left cuff (on the viewer's right when they face us); at her belt a needlework pouch with a small silver pair of scissors hanging from it; the brass thimble on her finger. She stands with a half-mended sleeve held in both hands, a patient, gentle look.
private: Sitting at the tent flap: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool house dress to the shins under a knitted grey shawl, warm stockings and soft shoes, the two plaits over her chest. She sews a small patch onto a child's sock, an absorbed, soft look.
battle: Not a fighter; tending the wounded at the edge of the camp: the pale grey robe with the sleeves tied back with cloth, the needlework pouch at her belt, a clean linen apron over the robe. She holds a threaded needle up in one hand and a roll of bandage in the other, the feet apart and steady, a firm, calm look.
battle_pose: 3) the field-tending outfit: steady and calm, the feet a little apart and planted, holding a threaded needle up in one hand and a roll of bandage in the other, a firm, composed expression; she does not fight.
formal: Dressed for the feast she is sent to: a clean pale grey robe with wide sleeves, left loose at the neck with a plain ribbon tie, the cuffs freshly embroidered by her mother's hand with a name in white thread that shimmers softly, the plaits tied with a plain ribbon. A small silver pair of scissors at her belt. She stands very straight with her hands folded in front, a solemn, careful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the dark gold eyes open and looking straight at the viewer with a quiet, serious look, the mouth closed. Soft lamplight from a tent on one side, cool dusk light on the other. Foreground blur: a loose thread and the glint of a brass thimble. She wears the pale grey robe with the embroidered cuff.

name: 扎伊娜
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1391
who: Zaina, a flame-horn demon woman, a vanguard soldier of the Horned Plain war-band, a hundred and eighteen years old and looking about twenty-five: about 181 cm, tall, broad-shouldered, strongly built. Skin charcoal black with a red undertone. A pair of thick horns curving forward, a ring of old burn scars at their roots, the tips always burning with a small flame that glows like two little lamps at night. Orange-red eyes. Short, messy dark hair, singed ragged at the ends. A loud, fierce, restless air; when she swears, the flames on her horns jump higher. Her skin is a true charcoal black, as dark as soot, with a red undertone glowing through at the cheeks, shoulders and knuckles; NOT brown and NOT tan, the same deep charcoal in every panel. Her skin is NEAR-BLACK, as dark as coal or black coffee, far darker than any brown or copper skin; the red undertone is only a faint ember glow at the cheeks, shoulders and knuckles, and the base colour of the skin stays black in every panel.
build: 181 cm, tall and powerfully built: wide shoulders, a strong back, thick bare arms, a C-cup, a tight waist and full hips.
palette: charcoal black and ember red, red bronze, orange flame, scorched leather brown
casual: Her flame-horn gear: a red-bronze breastplate over a dark short-sleeved undershirt, both arms bare to the shoulder, dark leather trousers and heavy boots. On her back a big round shield; in her right hand a long-handled war hammer whose head was tempered in her own body heat. She grins fiercely, the horn flames bright.
private: Resting by the camp fire: the breastplate off, a loose sleeveless dark linen shirt, dark trousers rolled to the calf, bare arms, heavy boots unlaced. She sits with a clay bowl of stew in both hands, the horn flames burning low, a gruff, relaxed look.
battle: Charging at the front: the red-bronze breastplate etched with branching copper sorcery lines, bare arms, leather bracers on the wrists, a ring of old burn scars round her horns. The big shield held braced before her on her left arm, the long-handled war hammer raised in her right hand, the horn flames roaring high and the hammer head glowing red. A fierce, shouting look.
formal: At a war-band muster: the red-bronze breastplate polished, a short dark red cloak over one shoulder, a dark leather belt with a plain bronze buckle, her ragged hair combed back. She stands tall with the shield grounded at her side and the hammer shaft resting on her shoulder, a proud, grim look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the orange-red eyes glaring at the viewer, a fierce, defiant grin with the lips closed, the two horn flames sharp in the frame. Hard orange light from the horn flames on the face, cold blue night behind. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and ash. She wears the red-bronze breastplate with bare arms.

name: 柯丝
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1538
who: Kos, a young demon-kin archer of the Bow-Back Ridge, seventeen years old: slight and long-limbed, about 158 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. Two small thin horns, a matched pair, one growing above the LEFT temple and one above the RIGHT temple: each is a short dark spike about a finger long that pokes up clear of the hair and sweeps back, the two the same size and the same shape, the hair parted round them so BOTH horns are always in view; a head showing only one horn is wrong. Deep blue-green short hair, messy, with one thin braid at the left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us) ending in a grey-white feather. Gold-green eyes that open wide when she looks far away. Pale skin, both cheeks reddened by the ridge wind. Three fingers of her right hand (on the viewer's left) are wrapped in thin worn leather guards. A shy, serious, earnest air; her hands shake until the string is drawn. The two horns are a matched pair of the same length and thickness, each a short thin spike sweeping back over the hair, both clearly visible in every panel. The two horns are the SAME height and the same curve, mirror images of each other, each rising the same distance above the hair; in no panel is one horn taller, longer or more curved than the other.
palette: deep blue-green and gold-green, deerskin brown, grey-white feather, wind-red cheeks
casual: Her hill archer's clothes: a short deerskin jerkin with the sleeves rolled to the elbow over a plain linen shirt, a wide leather belt, sturdy trousers and boots; at her belt a quiver her mother sewed with a ring of feathers round its mouth, and one arrow wrapped in cloth beside it. A horn bow with her name carved in the back is slung across her back. She stands with one hand on the bow strap, a bright, earnest look. Both horns show, one over each temple, the same size.
private: Resting at the ridge camp: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool tunic to the knee over warm leggings, the jerkin off, soft boots, the braid and feather loose. She holds a mug of warm milk in both hands, an earnest, quiet look. Both horns show, one over each temple, the same size.
battle: On the ridge in the wind: the deerskin jerkin laced firmly, leather bracers, the leather finger guards on her right hand, the quiver feathers stirring. She draws the horn bow to full and aims straight ahead along the arrow, whose tip carries a faint ember glow, the feet planted. A steady, intent look, the mouth closed. Both horns show, one over each temple, the same size.
formal: At the ridge gathering: a short dark green deerskin jerkin laced at the front over a pale linen shirt, a quiver sewn by her mother with a ring of grey-white feathers round its mouth, a brown leather belt, the feather braid freshly tied, the horn bow left off. The feathers lift gently as if in a wind that is not there. She stands straight with her hands folded in front, a solemn, nervous look. Both horns show, one over each temple, the same size.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the gold-green eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer with an earnest, serious look, the mouth closed. Cold wind-blown light from one side, a warm low sun on the other. Foreground blur: a grey-white feather and the fletching of an arrow. She wears the deerskin jerkin with the feather braid at her ear.

name: 基利安
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1594
who: Kilian, a human tower hand and wind-watcher, thirty-five years old: about 178 cm, medium height, thin, with wide shoulders and long arms from a lifetime of hanging off the edge of towers. Flax-coloured curly hair a year uncut, tied back at the nape with a piece of straw rope. Light blue eyes. A small lead plumb weight pierced through his left earlobe (on the viewer's right when they face us). A face without much colour, the pallor of a year shut in a pen. A bandaged old arrow wound on the upper left leg (on the viewer's right) that never closed, so he walks dragging that leg. A wry, dry, stubborn air; he still complains about the food, which means he still wants to live.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of about thirty-five, tired and pale, NOT boyish: light blue, slightly narrowed eyes with faint lines at their corners; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a dry mouth with a faint stubborn set. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 178 cm, thin: wide shoulders, long strong arms, a lean frame wasted by a year of confinement.
palette: flax and canvas, lead grey, light blue, bandage cream, a little scorched brown
casual: His tower hand's clothes: a canvas tower coat whose cuffs are scorched, torn places stitched with scavenged broken bowstring; the left trouser leg slit open and wound with a cloth bandage over the old wound, boots worn down. At his belt only a short bare leather cord that once held a notebook, now empty. He stands with his weight on the right leg and a wry, weary look.
private: Resting in the shelter: the canvas coat off, a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, the same bandaged trousers, a blanket over one shoulder. He sits with his bandaged leg stretched out, picking at a hard biscuit, a sour, tired look.
battle: Hanging on a tower edge in high wind: the canvas coat buckled, a climbing rope belayed round his waist and across the chest, leather gloves, the bandaged leg braced on a ledge. He swings a lead plumb weight on a long cord in one hand, reading the wind, the other hand gripping the rope; he carries no weapon. A sharp, focused look.
battle_pose: 3) the tower-edge outfit: braced and focused, the weight on the sound leg and the bandaged leg braced on a ledge, one hand gripping a rope and the other swinging a lead plumb weight on a cord; he carries no weapon.
formal: At a tower crew's muster: a clean grey wool coat with thread stripes sewn at the cuffs, brushed canvas over-tunic, boots wiped clean, the hair tied neatly back, the lead weight at his ear. He stands stiffly with his hands behind his back and his weight on the right leg, a dry, wary look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light blue eyes looking skyward past the viewer, one half-narrowed, a dry, stubborn look, the mouth closed. Cold white sky light from above on one side, a low warm light on the other. Foreground blur: drifting ash, a swinging lead plumb weight on a cord. He wears the scorched canvas coat with the lead weight at his left ear.

name: 穆克
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1731
who: Muk, a human wall-mender of the southern wall, seventy-five years old: about 166 cm, short and stocky, his back still straight. Short white hair and a short white beard trimmed close so mortar does not cling to it. Pale water-blue eyes. A thick callus on the outer rim of his right ear (on the viewer's left when they face us), from thirty years of listening with his ear pressed to stone. Two broad, rough hands with mortar ground into the nails. A gruff, patient, slow-spoken air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, weathered old man's face of about seventy-five, NOT young: deep lines at the eyes and mouth, pale water-blue eyes, heavy white eyebrows, a flattened nose, a short white beard. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 166 cm, short and stocky: wide solid shoulders, short strong legs, thick forearms, a barrel chest.
palette: mortar white and stone grey, water blue, old leather brown, a little rust
casual: His mender's clothes: an old leather apron of no remembered colour over a rough shirt and trousers, thick leather knee pads he sewed himself strapped over both knees, heavy boots. At his belt a trowel and a stone hammer; on his back a wooden bucket of mortar with a ring of white crust round its rim. He stands with a trowel in one hand, a slow, patient look.
private: At rest in the wall-foot hut: the apron and knee pads off, a loose undyed wool shirt, braces over it, plain trousers, soft felt slippers. He rubs one knee with a broad hand while sitting on an upturned bucket, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Holding a breach in the wall: the leather apron buckled, knee pads on, a battered iron helmet, thick leather gloves. He braces against a half-built wall with the stone hammer raised in his right hand and the trowel in his left, the mortar bucket at his feet. A stubborn, grim look.
formal: At the wall's spring muster: a clean dark brown wool coat with wooden buttons over a white shirt, the apron left off, his white beard freshly trimmed, the trowel tucked into his belt. He stands very upright with his hands behind his back, a dignified, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale water-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer with a patient, knowing look, the mouth closed. Grey overcast light from one side, a warm lantern glow on the other. Foreground blur: drifting lime dust and a wet trowel. He wears the old leather apron.

name: 琪莎
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1786
who: Kisha, a young tiefling newcomer on the southern wall, sixteen years old: small and thin, about 151 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. Honey-orange short hair in uneven tufts, cut with a knife by herself. Two short horns sweeping back from her forehead corners, the colour of old ivory, with no fire in them. Ice-blue eyes. The backs of her hands covered in small scrapes from stone. A sharp-eyed, stubborn, shy air; she throws a stone more accurately than most soldiers shoot an arrow. No wings, no tail.
palette: honey orange and ivory, ice blue, oversized faded wool grey-brown, stone grey
casual: Her wall-crew clothes: an oversized old coat left behind by a dead crew-mate, the sleeves rolled up three times, over plain trousers and boots she sleeps in. At her belt a cloth bag full of fist-sized pieces of gravel, each one chosen and round. She stands with one hand holding a round stone, a shy, bright look.
private: Resting in the barracks corner: the big coat folded over her knees, a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool tunic to the knee over leggings, the boots still on, the short hair tousled. She sits cross-legged sorting round stones into the bag, a quiet, calm look, the eyes fully open and the mouth closed.
battle: Throwing from the wall: the oversized coat buckled to the collar, sleeves rolled, leather gloves, the bag of round stones at her belt. She winds up with one stone in her right hand, the left arm pointed forward at the target, the feet planted. A fierce, concentrated look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the wall crew's first muster: a grey wool crew coat with the sleeves taken up, worn open at the neck over a plain linen shirt and fastened with a broad leather strap, a cloth bag of round gravel stones at her belt, one stone glowing faintly warm. Boots wiped clean, the short hair combed flat. She stands straight with her hands at her sides, a nervous, earnest look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the ice-blue eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer with an earnest, serious look, the mouth closed. Cold grey dawn light from one side, a faint warm torchlight on the other. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and a smooth round stone held up near her chin. She wears the oversized old coat.

name: 奥雷利奥
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1935
who: Aurelio, a human caravan leader and crown-bearer of the Sun Disc exiles, fifty years old: about 181 cm, tall and spare, his back slightly bowed from carrying. Honey-coloured skin weathered by years of desert sun, deep lines on his face like the lee side of a dune. Light amber eyes that narrow when he looks into the distance. A grey-streaked beard cut short, two deep smile lines at the corners of his mouth. Both hands are thick with rope calluses. A calm, wry, patient air; he stands at the head of the caravan and the road seems to be under his feet.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of about fifty, weathered, NOT young: light amber eyes narrowed against distance, with fine lines at their corners; level grey-streaked brows; a short grey-streaked beard; two deep smile lines. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 181 cm, spare and long: narrow shoulders marked by pressure from two leather straps, long legs, strong knees.
palette: faded sunset orange and sand, light amber, rope brown, dusty grey
casual: His crown-bearer's gear: a faded sunset-coloured long robe with the hood up and pulled low over the brow, though the eyes stay clear; on his back a wooden box wrapped in a cloth with a worn sun-disc pattern (a circle with rays) rubbed almost invisible, held by two leather straps crossing his chest. At his belt a coil of rope tied with knots, one knot for each hundred miles. He stands with one hand on a strap, a calm, patient look.
private: At rest by a caravan fire: the box set down beside him, the robe loose with the hood back, the sleeves rolled, soft leather sandals. He sits turning a knotted rope through his fingers, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Leading the caravan through a dust storm: the sunset robe belted, a cloth wrapped over the nose and mouth with the amber eyes clear above it, the box strapped on his back. He holds a long staff planted in front of him in one hand and raises the other arm to signal the line to halt. A firm, alert look.
formal: At the exiles' gathering under the tower: a faded sunset-coloured robe worn open over a plain brown tunic, a broad leather sash with a brass sun-disc clasp, the hood down, the sun-disc cloth folded over the box on his back, his beard freshly trimmed. A thin ring of faded gold runs round the hem and shifts slowly like a setting sun. He stands upright with his hands folded in front, a grave, dignified look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light amber eyes narrowed and looking out past the viewer toward a far horizon, a faint wry smile with the lips closed. Low gold desert sun from one side, cool dusk light on the other. Foreground blur: blowing sand and a knotted rope. He wears the faded sunset-coloured robe with the hood up.

name: 里纳尔多
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:1991
who: Rinaldo, a human fire-keeper of the tower furnace, forty-two years old and looking fifty: about 176 cm, thin and wiry. Both forearms layered with burn scars, eyebrows burned away so often they are almost gone. Dark orange eyes, narrowed from twenty years of watching flame, a spark of reflected fire always in the pupils. Short cropped hair streaked with ash grey. A faded cloth with a sun-disc pattern wound round his head as a band. A quiet, steady, gruff air; when he stands at the furnace mouth the furnace stops complaining. His exile's robe closes down the front with plain round buttons and has fitted sleeves; no looped-cord toggles or knotted frog fasteners anywhere, in any panel. The sun-disc pattern of the exiles is a small plain gold wheel-shaped disc with a thin outer ring and short spokes, worked in dull gold thread on faded ochre-brown cloth, and the sun-disc badge is the same wheel cast in dull bronze; the cloth carries no other colour.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean weathered man's face of about fifty, NOT young: dark orange eyes narrowed against heat, almost no eyebrows, creased cheeks, a firm thin mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 176 cm, thin and wiry: hard sinewy forearms, a strong back, a lean frame.
palette: dark orange and ash grey, scorched leather brown, faded sunset red, soot black
casual: His fire-keeper's clothes: a thick leather apron with a sun-disc badge pinned on the chest, over an old patched exile's robe, the sleeves rolled to the elbow to show the burn scars; the faded sun-disc cloth wound round his head. He carries a pair of tongs longer than his arm in both hands. He stands with the tongs upright, a gruff, steady look.
private: Off shift on the stairs: the apron off, only the patched exile's robe with the sleeves rolled and a rough wool blanket over his shoulders, the head cloth loosened. He sits with a mug of hot water, staring at nothing, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Defending the furnace: the leather apron buckled over the robe, thick leather gauntlets to the elbow, a smoke-blackened helmet. He holds the long tongs in both hands, a glowing coal gripped in their jaws, braced at the furnace mouth, the fire lighting his face. A grim, unflinching look.
formal: At the tower's evening rite: a clean dark robe of the exiles, mended but brushed, a leather belt, the sun-disc badge pinned over the heart, the head cloth neatly folded and tied. He stands straight with his hands folded in front, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark orange eyes narrowed and looking steadily at the viewer, the mouth closed. Hard orange light from a furnace mouth on one side, cold blue dusk on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and ash. He wears the leather apron with the sun-disc badge.

name: 英格丽
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:2047
who: Ingrid of the Furnace-Vein dwarf line, a dwarf furnace-smith of the sand-edge tower camp, a hundred and sixty years old and looking about thirty, a grown woman: about 133 cm, short, stout and broad-shouldered. A thick copper-red braid coiled on top of her head. Patches of soot on her face that never wash off. Ice-blue eyes narrowed to slits when she looks at fire. Both forearms covered with layers of old burn scars and ten fingers black as coal. A gruff, proud, practical air; the furnace knows who has been firing it.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf woman's face of about thirty, round and strong-boned, a grown woman's face and NOT a child's: ice-blue eyes narrowed to slits, with faint laugh lines at their corners; straight copper-red brows; a broad nose with soot smudges; a firm, wide mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 133 cm, short and stout: thick shoulders, strong blackened hands, a D-cup, a solid waist and broad hips.
palette: copper red and ice blue, soot black, scorched leather brown, brass
casual: Her tower furnace-smith's clothes: a thick leather apron of the Furnace-Vein line whose front is burned through with holes, over a rough shirt with the sleeves rolled, a smoked-mica goggle pushed up onto her forehead; at her belt a furnace hammer, and on a chain beside it a small copper pocket dial engraved with her own scale of fire colours; on her wrist a leather cord tied with seven knots, one knot for each tower. She stands with the hammer shaft on one shoulder, a gruff, confident grin.
private: After the shift in the camp: the apron off, a loose sleeveless undyed shirt, patched breeches, bare forearms with the scars showing, the goggle on the table, the braid loosened. She sits on an upturned crate eating black bread, a content, tired look.
battle: At the tower's furnace heart: the burned apron buckled, leather gauntlets to the elbow, the smoked-mica goggle pulled down over her eyes. She swings the furnace hammer in both hands against a glowing bar on the anvil, the sparks flying, her feet planted wide. A fierce, absorbed look.
formal: At the founders' table: a clean dark leather jerkin of her line with brass fittings over a white linen shirt, the apron left off, the copper braid coiled and pinned with a brass pin, the goggle hung at her neck. She stands very upright with her hands folded in front, a proud, solemn look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the ice-blue eyes narrowed and looking straight at the viewer with a fierce, knowing grin with the lips closed. Hard orange furnace light on one side, cool blue light on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and soot. She wears the burned leather apron.

name: 耶勒
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:2188
who: Yel, a human wind-watcher of the First Tower, sixteen years old: thin, light, narrow-shouldered, about 163 cm, wholly covered by his clothes. Short silver-blue hair tousled up by the wind of the wind platform. Pale amber eyes whose pupils shrink small when he looks far away. Very fair skin, almost translucent, because tower children see little sun, and both ears red from the cold. A shy, quick, earnest air; a strong gust pushes him forward two steps.
palette: silver blue and pale amber, tower grey, lead grey, wind-red ears
casual: His tower wind-watcher's clothes: an old wool tower jacket with two lines of thread sewn at the cuffs, one on the left cuff for the wind platform and one on the right cuff for his mother's guard squad (on the viewer's right and left respectively when they face us), plain trousers and thin soft-soled shoes. At his belt hangs a small lead plumb weight on a cord. He stands with his hands at his sides, an earnest, bright look.
private: Resting in the tower room: the jacket off, a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool shirt and plain trousers, a grey knitted scarf, thick socks. He sits on the floor holding a mug of hot water in both hands, a sleepy, earnest look.
battle: Not a fighter; on the wind platform in a gale: the tower jacket buttoned to the collar, a safety line clipped round his waist to the rail, leather gloves. He holds the lead plumb weight out on its cord over the edge in one hand and a small notebook in the other, the feet braced apart. A serious, concentrated look.
battle_pose: 3) the wind-platform outfit: braced and concentrated, the feet wide apart, a safety line round the waist, holding a lead plumb weight on a cord out in one hand and a small notebook in the other; he does not fight.
formal: At the tower crew's muster: a clean grey wool coat belted with a plain strap, worn with a folded low collar, the two thread stripes freshly stitched at the cuffs, a canvas over-tunic brushed, the hair combed flat, thin soft shoes wiped clean. The lead plumb weight hangs at his belt and sways slightly even in still air. He stands straight with his hands behind his back, a solemn, nervous look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale amber eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer with an earnest, serious look, the mouth closed. Cold bright sky light from one side, a faint warm glow on the other. Foreground blur: a swinging lead plumb weight and drifting snow. He wears the old tower jacket with the thread stripes at his cuffs.

name: 宁梅丝
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:2243
who: Ninmeis, a rock-mender and an elf of the Elven Court, a watcher, about six hundred years old and looking about twenty-seven or twenty-eight: about 176 cm, tall and slender. Long pointed elf ears of two different lengths: the LEFT ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us) is long and ends in a fine sharp point, while the RIGHT ear (on the viewer's left when she faces us) is a full finger-width shorter and ends blunt and squared-off, its point sliced away long ago by a bone spear; from any distance one ear is pointed and the other is cut short. Long dark green hair braided into one thick braid coiled at the back of her head. Mist-violet eyes. Every fingertip carries faint shallow marks from four hundred years of gripping a carving knife. A calm, unhurried, watchful air; she has looked the same for four hundred years. The RIGHT ear (on the viewer's LEFT when she faces us) is missing a small piece from its very tip, a clean notch bitten out of the point, clearly drawn in every panel; the LEFT ear tip is whole. The RIGHT ear (on the viewer's LEFT when she faces us) is visibly SHORTER than the left: the last finger-width of its point is gone, replaced by a blunt squared-off end with a small V-shaped bite out of it, so the two ears are plainly different lengths in every panel, in the portrait and in all nine expressions; the LEFT ear keeps its full sharp point.
build: 176 cm, tall and slender: a long neck, narrow shoulders, a B-cup, a soft narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: dark green and mist violet, grey-brown leather, mountain-bronze, a little pale stone
casual: Her rock-mender's clothes: a grey-brown leather suit with thick leather patches at the knees and elbows over a plain shirt and trousers and soft boots; at her belt a string of mountain-bronze clamp bands, a small carving knife and a bag of wedges; a watcher's long bow slung across her back, never taken off in four hundred years. She stands with one hand on the bow strap, a calm, watchful look. The ear on the viewer's left is the short blunt one, the ear on the viewer's right long and pointed.
private: Resting in a rock crevice: the leather suit off, a loose long-sleeved undyed linen tunic over leggings, soft slippers, the braid over one shoulder. She sits cross-legged carving small marks into a pebble, a quiet, absent look. The ear on the viewer's left is the short blunt one, the ear on the viewer's right long and pointed.
battle: Hanging in the crevices under a floating rock: the leather suit buckled, a rope round her waist, fingerless gloves. She draws the long bow to full, one foot wedged in a crack, the arrow aimed along her gaze. A cool, intent look. The ear on the viewer's left is the short blunt one, the ear on the viewer's right long and pointed.
formal: At the Elven Court's audience: a long dark green wool coat open at the neck and fastened with a silver leaf clasp, fine silver leaf embroidery at the cuffs over the grey-brown shirt, the braid pinned up with a bronze pin, the bow left on her back. The silver leaves turn slowly like leaves in a current. She stands very upright with her hands folded in front, a dignified, serene look. The ear on the viewer's left is the short blunt one, the ear on the viewer's right long and pointed.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the mist-violet eyes looking steadily at the viewer, a faint calm look with the lips closed, the nicked right ear tip clear in the frame. Cold pale light from one side, a warm lantern glow from the other. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and a glinting carving knife. She wears the grey-brown leather suit with the bronze bands at her belt.

name: 丹克瓦特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:2298
who: Dankvart, a tiefling bone-gatherer of the sand-edge camp, born at the edge of the dead lands, sixty-four years old and looking early forties: about 184 cm, tall, thin and a little stooped. A pair of short horns curving back toward his skull, the tips polished smooth. His left eye is dark red and his right eye sand yellow (on the viewer's right and left respectively when they face us). Short hair of faded rust red. Both hands chalk-white, as if dusted with flour, yet warm to the touch. A quiet, wry, wary air; his shadow on the sand seems shorter than other people's. Eye colours by side when he faces us: the eye on the viewer's LEFT (his right eye) is sand yellow, the eye on the viewer's RIGHT (his left eye) is dark red; red on the viewer's right, yellow on the viewer's left, in every panel and in the portrait.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of about forty, sunken-cheeked and tired, NOT boyish: one dark red eye and one sand-yellow eye, level rust-red brows, a straight nose, a closed dry mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 184 cm, tall and thin: long arms, narrow shoulders sagging a little under a heavy load, a lean frame.
palette: sand and dusty buff, dark red and sand yellow eyes, rust red, bone white
casual: His bone-gatherer's clothes: a sand-coloured coarse cloth jacket and trousers, a strip of cloth wound round the neck to the collarbone, covering a mark. On his back a tall wicker basket; at his belt a bone-picking hook, and a full water skin. He stands with one hand on the basket strap, a wry, quiet look.
private: Resting in the camp tent: the basket off, a loose long-sleeved sand-coloured linen shirt with the neck cloth still wound, plain trousers, soft boots, a blanket over his knees. He sits with a mug of water and a small clean bone in his white hand, a quiet, absent look.
battle: Crossing the dust flats: the coarse jacket buttoned, a cloth over the nose and mouth with both mismatched eyes clear above it, the basket strapped on his back. He holds the bone-picking hook in both hands ahead of him like a short pole, ready to ward off, the feet planted. A wary, alert look.
formal: At the camp's burial rite: a long dark sand-coloured coat of coarse cloth worn open over the neck cloth, tied with a plain rope belt, bone tokens hung at the chest, the hair neat, the horns bare, no basket. A faint pale light follows the bone tokens when he moves. He stands very straight with his hands folded in front, a grave, quiet look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark red left eye and sand-yellow right eye looking steadily at the viewer, a wry look with the lips closed, the polished horns clear in the frame. Low hard sand-gold light from one side, cool blue shadow on the other. Foreground blur: blowing sand and a chalk-white hand holding a pale bone. He wears the sand-coloured jacket with the neck cloth.
